Immunosuppressants (e.g. cyclosporine A, azathioprine, methotrexate, sulfasalazine, mycophenolate mofetil, everolimus, ibrutinib)

value.population_note: All medications/treatments that could affect Alopecia Areata must be discontinued (Section 5.8.2) -- study drug (ritlecitinib/PF-06651600) is the sole permitted AA treatment, so regimen_type is set to monotherapy even though this is not an AD/TCS trial.

background_therapy.source_excerpt: Section 5.8.2 Prohibited Medications and Treatments: 'All medications and treatments that could affect AA must be discontinued. During the study if it is discovered that a subject has been taking a medication or treatment that could affect AA, the investigator should contact the Sponsor for each case to determine whether the subject should be discontinued.' Prohibited list includes 'JAK inhibitors for use in any disease indication', 'Immunosuppressants (eg, cyclosporine A, azathioprine, methotrexate [MTX], sulfasalazine, mycophenolate mofetil [MMF], everolimus, ibrutinib)', 'Intralesional, oral or injectable steroids', 'Topical treatments that could affect AA on areas under assessment... (eg, steroid cream, medicated shampoo, minoxidil)', 'Phototherapy', 'Contact immunotherapy'.

multiplicity_control.source_excerpt: SAP Section 5.1 Hypotheses and Decision Rules: 'The study is tested at an overall α = 0.05... more stringent levels have been advised for regulatory submission... ie, 1% for EMA and competent authorities in the VHP countries, and 0.125% for the FDA/PMDA.' Section 5.1.1: 'The family-wise Type I error will be strongly controlled using a gatekeeping approach as described in the following order and shown in Figure 2... The primary endpoint for 200 mg QD/50 mg QD dose regimen (H1) will be tested at α significance level first. If significant, then the primary endpoint for 50 mg QD dose regimen and the 200 mg QD/30 mg QD dose regimen (H2 and H3)... will be tested simultaneously.' Section 5.1.2 (FDA/PMDA): 'The family-wise Type I error will be strongly controlled using a gate-keeping approach to test these hypotheses in 3 groups... The statistical significance of the first hypothesis (H1) will allow simultaneous testing of H2 and H3 using Holm's method... The 10 mg group comparison to placebo is not included in the Type I error controlled procedure.' Figures 2 and 3 are titled 'Schematic and Graphical Presentation for Multiple Testing Procedure'.

value.dosing_interval: Once daily (QD) oral tablets; 7 tablets/day during the loading phase (Weeks 0-4), 4 tablets/day during the maintenance phase (Weeks 4-24), 7 tablets/day for the first 4 weeks of the extension phase, then 4 tablets/day for the remainder of the extension phase

study_schedule.source_excerpt: Study Design: 'This is a Phase 2b/3, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, dose-ranging study to investigate PF-06651600 in AA. The study will have a maximum duration of approximately 57 weeks. This includes an up to 5-week Screening period, a 48-week treatment period, and a 4-week follow-up period... The treatment period will be comprised of a placebo-controlled period that includes a 4-week loading phase and a 20-week maintenance phase, followed by a 24-week extension phase.' 'All subjects will begin dosing during the loading phase... Following the 4-week loading phase, subjects will continue dosing... in the 20-week maintenance phase. At the end of the maintenance phase, placebo-treated subjects will be advanced in a prespecified, blinded manner to one of 2 active treatment sequences for the remainder of the study (through Week 48)... both discontinued and completed subjects will enter into a 4-week follow-up period... Subjects who complete treatment may be eligible for enrollment in a long-term study (Phase 3 study B7981032).' Primary endpoint is SALT<=20 at Week 24.
